definitions.gloss: prepared side dish; ready-made dish; deli food
definitions.explanation: Cooked dishes sold ready to eat, typically found at supermarkets, department store basements (depachika), and specialty shops. Includes items like fried chicken, salads, simmered vegetables, and more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総菜|そうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's buy some deli food on the way home today.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総菜|そうざい}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The deli section at the supermarket gets cheaper in the evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総菜|そうざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: On busy days I often rely on prepared dishes, but I try to watch the nutritional balance.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common word in daily Japanese life. Also written as ⟦お{惣菜|そうざい}→お惣菜：15235_osouzai⟧ with the polite prefix お. Supermarkets and department store basements (⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧, commonly called ⟦デパ{地下|ちか}→デパ地下：08828_depachika⟧) have extensive {総菜|そうざい} sections.

WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧. Both kanji forms are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総菜|そうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy prepared food)
- {総菜|そうざい}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ (deli section)
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧{総菜|そうざい} (homemade side dishes)
